ag_main.temperature: not sent (unsupported by the model on OpenRouter)

explorer.actions: click, select, check, radio, fill-and-submit, fill-only field groups, hover, WAI-ARIA keys, Escape on dialogs
explorer.bounds_choice: dev reach 2026-11-18: base 86/137 (Checkout 69/110); base + completion: Checkout 69/110; wide (k8, n200, d6): Checkout 70/110 -> paper bounds kept, completion pass added

change_record.extraction_caps: links 600, images 400, buttons 400, form controls 400, headings 300

v4_note: restore of the start state after a fresh reload accepts URL+route+title (D5 apps with live data); check-page (D2/D3/D6) never restores a state, so the v3 external results are unchanged under v4
v5_note: highlight boxes clipped to the screenshot (a crash on elements outside it); verdicts elsewhere unchanged

single_page_mode.judged: the case's element once; page cases at depth <= 1
single_page_mode.destination_peek: read-only GET of link targets without a recorded outcome
single_page_mode.time_budget: when a harness limits the time per page (ACCESSGRAPH_TIME_BUDGET_S; Rampa harness 180 s -> 165 s), each call gets at most the time left, calls after the limit count as uncertain, and the follow-up is skipped with < 30 s left; no limit in InterA11y harness (D2) or on apps

uncertain_followup.evidence: destination peek, element pressed on a fresh load (allowed hosts), image render
uncertain_followup.rule: more decided votes wins; tie -> uncertain

model_calls.timeout_scope: whole request (not only each socket read)
model_calls.why: v6 D6: six pages lost to model calls that stalled for minutes while the reply trickled in (normal answers ~4 s, slowest seen 40 s)

v8_changes.link_context: a link in a nested list also gets the parent list item text (programmatic_context.parent_list_items; WCAG technique H81); guidance names it
v8_changes.form_labels: guidance: a generic label naming no purpose ('Field 1', 'Input', 'Text', 'Value', 'Box') is a violation even if the field's purpose is not otherwise grounded (parallel to the heading guidance)

v9_changes.same_name_links: guidance: an equivalent resource is the same content in the same form; different formats or versions of one item are different destinations

v10_changes.recordings: single-page recordings are reused only by the code that made them (hash of the frozen files in recorded_with.json); older ones are set aside and the page is recorded again
v10_changes.destination_peek: saved local HTML pages (file://) are peeked like web pages; destinations of other links with the same name are peeked too (peeked_destination); headings are the rendered ones; main_text added
v10_changes.same_name_links: guidance: removed the example 'two ways to contact the same organisation' (contradicts ACT fd3a94); equivalent = same main content even if navigation or breadcrumbs differ
v10_changes.practice_check: D2 practice half (dev_round2, $0.49): expert F1 0.917 (v9 0.870), conformance 0.901 (v9 0.765)

v11_changes.jsonl_line_separators: candidate files are written ASCII-escaped and read by newline only, so page text with U+2028 cannot split a JSON line (D2 v10 run 1 case C629 failed on this); v10 recordings re-marked for v11 (recorded_with_v10 in recorded_with.json): recording and candidate code are unchanged

v12_changes.decision: PI 2026-11-18 ~19:55: fix round 4 from a failure analysis on all datasets (D2 as released, D3, D6, thesis dev cases, our 121 cases); general WCAG/ACT-based fixes only
v12_changes.hidden_images: recorder records images shown to sighted users but hidden from assistive technologies or marked decorative (aria-hidden, alt='', role none/presentation, svg/canvas without image role or name, CSS background images; >= 40x40 px); image candidates for them unless inside a named link/button; guidance: violation when informative (WCAG 1.1.1, F3)
v12_changes.visual_error_fields: form controls carry visual error signals (error/flag/attention class on field, wrapper, label, legend or fieldset; warning icon; red border); a field shown in error only visually is a 3.3.1 candidate (F81)
v12_changes.language_of_text_alternatives: alt/aria-label/aria-labelledby names count as text in the language of the element they name (ACT ucwvc8, off6ek): page text without own lang and passage text include them; a page whose only text is a text alternative gets a 3.1.1 candidate
v12_changes.form_values: form controls record their current value (never passwords); a control's outcome lists fields changed and fields that kept a value
v12_changes.scroll_before_recording: single-page mode scrolls the page once before exploring (lazy content)
v12_changes.guidance: error messages (a message stating a requirement the value fails is correct; message tied to the wrong field; visual-only errors), links (error/placeholder or generic entry-page destinations are not mismatch evidence except for in-page links; URL path as evidence when the destination cannot load), images (complex images naming only the subject; main point suffices; file name/src when the image did not load; hidden informative images), buttons/widgets (judge recorded changes, not the app's status message), autocomplete (billing/shipping tokens), language (text alternatives)

v13_changes.decision: PI 2026-11-19 ~14:00: fix round 5, all fixes from the re-analysis of D2 (expert: saved pages erased by their own scripts; conformance: never-judged cases and a hidden-image regression); general WCAG/ACT-based fixes only
v13_changes.saved_pages_as_saved: single-page mode, saved pages (files): when the page's own scripts erase its saved content offline (with scripts after 6 s < 50% of the saved elements or text), a copy of the saved file without <script> elements is recorded (with <base> to the original)
v13_changes.saved_images: saved pages: lazy images load at once; a source pointing online gives way to the 's saved copy
v13_changes.lookalike_letters: recorder: words mixing Latin with look-alike Greek/Cyrillic letters; image-alt candidates (WCAG 1.1.1 Understanding: characters used for their visual shape are non-text content)
v13_changes.small_icons: recorder: CSS background icons 8-40 px next to text, outside links/buttons (at most 10), as hidden images
v13_changes.canvas_svg_exposure: canvas without an image role is hidden even with aria-label; svg exposed through named role=img/graphics-symbol parts is not hidden
v13_changes.hidden_focusable_links: recorder: links inside aria-hidden that keyboard users can focus; link candidates (ACT 'Link has non-empty accessible name')
v13_changes.hidden_error_messages: recorder: error messages referenced by a field or its submit control but not shown, with the form's values; error-message candidates when a field is filled in
v13_changes.guidance: images (hidden images: illustrative/mood photos are decorative; image in a control with its own text may name the image; look-alike letters; role=img placeholders are what the page shows), links (aria-label replacing visible text with a generic phrase; hidden focusable links), errors (hidden error message while a filled-in value fails it; hint present before the error does not identify it)
